title: Wire up a real lint gate across all packages
description: Root package.json runs 'turbo run lint' but no package defines a lint script, so 'pnpm lint' exits green having executed nothing. In an autonomous loop this reports a passed quality gate that never ran. Add ESLint flat config + typescript-eslint at the root, add a lint script to all 4 packages (core, server, shared-types, web), and make turbo aware of the task.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm lint executes a real linter in all 4 packages; a deliberately introduced violation causes a non-zero exit; turbo.json declares the lint task
close_reason: Real lint gate wired up across all 4 packages; verified it fails closed on a deliberate violation. PR #1.

title: No test coverage for apps/web and packages/shared-types
description: Only core (36 tests) and server (5 tests) have vitest suites. apps/web and packages/shared-types define no test script, so the test gate cannot catch regressions there. The web visualizer can break with all gates green.
acceptance_criteria: Both packages have a test script wired into turbo; at least smoke-level coverage of the web app's rendering and the shared type contracts

title: Enable type-aware ESLint rules
description: The lint gate added in genebaer-n2y uses typescript-eslint's non-type-checked recommended set for speed and setup simplicity. Type-aware rules (no-floating-promises, no-misused-promises, await-thenable, strict-boolean-expressions) catch a materially different and more valuable class of bug, especially in packages/server where async streaming lives. Enable via projectService once the base gate is stable.
acceptance_criteria: eslint.config.mjs uses recommendedTypeChecked with projectService; pnpm lint still passes; a deliberate floating promise is caught
